g.text: Shares are of the tax-supported $204.3M, not of the $908M total.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #1c1a17

g.text: No social or income assistance line appears anywhere in this budget.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #1c1a17

g.text: Not underfunded — absent, because in Canada the function is provincial, not municipal.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #4a463f

g.text: Which is what makes it a worked example rather than an assertion: the gap is visible in the city's own published figures,

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #4a463f

g.text: and it is the gap a Delegated-Authority Mechanism projection has to be measured against.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: Real, published figures: the total budget, the tax-supported operating total, and the four-way split of tax-supported spending. Source: City of Kelowna,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: “Council approved 2025 Final Budget,” 28 April 2025 news release, kelowna.ca. One illustrative city's real numbers, offered as a worked example of what

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: a Delegated-Authority Mechanism projection could ground itself in — not a claim about what every municipal deployment will find, and not a statement

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: that this city is a deployment target.
